seed: A zoom on a cropped recording (the clip cropped with the Crop tool, the clip picked) fills the picture you can see with exactly what was inside the box you drew: its corners land on the picture's edges, its percent is how far in it really is, and the canvas shows what the export writes. Reported by the user on 2026-10-06: on a cropped video the zoom went far further in than the box and showed a different part of the picture.

steps.note: The zoom's box drawn round a spot of the cropped picture, its percent beside its corner
At the zoom's full point the picture you can see is exactly what was inside the box
